title: PatternMiner: Automated Mathematical Discovery Through LLM-Guided Training and Interpretation of Small Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33966v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: There are several approaches to AI-driven mathematical discovery. One of these involves the use of large language models (LLMs) to resolve well-specified conjectures via text-based reasoning, while another uses narrow models and interpretability for more open-ended, human-in-the-loop exploration using object-based mathematical data. The latter is limited in its ability to move beyond simple empirical pattern detection while the former is not well-designed for direct, open-ended exploration of large mathematical datasets. In this paper we introduce PatternMiner, a system that combines these two paradigms. In PatternMiner, an LLM agent generates mathematical datasets based on an initial broad question, trains narrow machine learning models on them, uses interpretability techniques to extract patterns from these trained models, and uses these patterns to formulate conjectures. translated_title: PatternMiner：通过大语言模型引导的小模型训练与解释实现自动化数学发现
translated_abstract: 人工智能驱动的数学发现已有若干种方法。其中一种方法是利用大语言模型（LLM）通过基于文本的推理来解决明确定义的猜想；另一种方法则使用窄域模型和可解释性技术，基于对象化的数学数据进行更开放式的、人在回路中的探索。前者的局限在于难以超越简单的经验性模式检测，而后者并不适合对大型数学数据集进行直接的开放式探索。本文介绍了PatternMiner，一个将这两种范式结合起来的系统。在PatternMiner中，一个LLM智能体基于初始的宽泛问题生成数学数据集，在其上训练窄域机器学习模型，使用可解释性技术从这些训练好的模型中提取模式，并利用这些模式形成猜想。一旦初始猜想被提出，PatternMiner便会……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PatternMiner首次将LLM文本推理与窄模型可解释性分析两种范式相结合，让LLM智能体自动生成数学数据集、训练小型机器学习模型、提取其中的模式并形成猜想，从而实现开放式、端到端的自动化数学发现。
en_tdlr: PatternMiner combines LLM-based text reasoning with narrow-model interpretability into a unified pipeline, where an LLM agent automatically generates mathematical datasets, trains small models, extracts patterns via interpretability techniques, and formulates conjectures, enabling open-ended automated mathematical discovery.
